general_news.title: Elliott has built stake in Deutsche Telekom, opposes T-Mobile merger, Bloomberg News reports
general_news.summary: Activist investor Elliott Investment Management has reportedly built a significant stake in Deutsche Telekom and is advocating against a potential merger with T-Mobile US. Elliott is urging the German telecom company to explore other avenues for increasing shareholder value, such as larger share buybacks. Deutsche Telekom holds a nearly 54% stake in its American arm, T-Mobile.

general_news.title: Costco reports August sales of $23.7 billion, up 9.9%
general_news.summary: Costco Wholesale Corporation reported strong sales figures for August, the fourth quarter, and the full fiscal year ended August 30, 2026. Net sales for August increased by 9.9% to $23.70 billion, while fourth-quarter net sales grew by 11.3% to $93.9 billion. The full fiscal year saw net sales reach $297.3 billion, marking a 10.2% increase from the previous year.

general_news.summary: The Hershey Company has announced the appointment of Dave Hulays as its new Chief Financial Officer. This announcement was made on September 2, 2026.

general_news.title: HPE follows in Dell’s footsteps as it rides the AI server boom to a big earnings beat
general_news.summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) reported strong July-quarter earnings, exceeding revenue and earnings per share expectations. The company attributes this success to increased demand for its AI server and networking portfolio, focusing on enterprise and sovereign customers. This performance mirrors Dell's recent surge, driven by the booming AI server market.

general_news.title: After 59 Years, Southwest Airlines Is Opening Its First Airport Lounges. Access Comes With 1 Big Catch
general_news.summary: Southwest Airlines is set to launch its first airport lounge network in late 2027, nearly six decades after its founding. This move is part of a 30-year partnership with Chase, aiming to offer premium travel perks. Access to these new lounges will exclusively be available through a new, premium Southwest Rapid Rewards® Credit Card issued by Chase, which will also launch in 2027.

general_news.title: Quanta Services declares $0.11 quarterly dividend

The dividend will be payable on October 9, 2026, to stockholders of record as of October 1, 2026, representing an annualized rate of $0.44 per share. Quanta Services specializes in providing infrastructure solutions across various industries in North America and other international markets.
